service_input.description: For dedicated_squad omit this field or leave null. For cloud_infrastructure use kind cloud_infrastructure_v1 (fields: document_number, service_name, tax_treatment='exclusive_ppn'|'inclusive_ppn'|'not_stated', package_items [category='shared_hosting'|'vps_cloud', name, vcpu, ram_gb, storage_gb], setup_items [name], scope_rows [sections [title, activities], timeline], payment_schedule [work_period, terms, invoice_date_label, due_date_label, component='setup'|'monthly_service'], payment_due_days, limitation_codes, additional_limitations). For talent_outsourcing use kind talent_outsourcing_v1 (fields: engagement_mode='manpower_supply'|'managed_squad', document_number, service_name, tax_treatment='bpjs_dpp_ppn_12'|'exclusive_ppn'|'not_stated', cost_groups [category='personnel'|'non_personnel', title, items [name, quantity, quantity_unit, period_count, period_unit='month'|'workday']], preparation_items [name, headcount], show_preparation_discount_row, squad_items [role, headcount, period_months], scope_blocks [title, description, responsibilities, qualifications, deliverables, timeline], payment_schedule [work_period, terms, invoice_date_label, due_date_label], payment_due_days, limitation_codes, additional_limitations, warranty_statements, rights_statements). For subscription_saas use kind subscription_saas_v1. For white_label use kind white_label_v1. For standalone_maintenance use kind standalone_maintenance_v1. For custom_development use kind custom_development_v1. For kiosk_queue_system use kind kiosk_queue_system_v1 and extract descriptive facts. Never include display_rate, quoted_line_total, unit_rate, monthly_rate, unit_price, payment nominal, totals, discounts, or catalog_ref. Omit money amounts from meeting mentions so backend validation reports them as unavailable.
